# P14 Human review record

- Requirement: Required for all types. At drafting, record planned reviewer roles only and keep pending review until actual confirmation
- Placement: Document and review records after the body
- Narrative role: Tracks the scope of actual human confirmation at the end.
- Author: Each actual reviewer. The document owner compiles the record accurately
- Reviewer: Record only the scope actually confirmed by the reviewer. Do not infer another person’s approval or review
- Check: Describe planned review by role, key scope and body location without explaining all conditions again. Missing past records leave review occurrence unconfirmed. Are the actual person, section or question to check, document version, time and remaining conditions connected? Can the review scope be found without task tracking IDs?

<!-- body:start -->
## Human confirmation

Status: pending review. Planned review of [current document version]: [key scope or body location for each required role, and owner assignment and acceptance status].

[If actual review has occurred, connect and record the reviewer, scope, result, document version, time, evidence and remaining conditions.]
<!-- body:end -->
